_comment: Locked OSF-filing values for the Att. M-2 §2 second-branch reconstruction. See tariff_snapshot.md for full citations. ComEdNPL, AComEdCPL, and the capacity rate come from primary published sources. portfolio_sum_mw is the only stipulation: ComEd computes it internally each year from customer-register data and does not publish current-year values. The FERC ER22-1520-001 deficiency response (Exhibits 1(b), 2(b)(i), 2(b)(ii)) discloses the Summer 2021 value for Weather Sensitive Customers as 2,033.653 MW. Per EXPERIMENT_DESIGN.md §6, Layer 2 is reported across three pre-registered named scenarios (low/anchor_2021/high), NOT as a single point estimate with a confidence band.

pjm_wn_peaks.title: PJM Weather-Normalized Peaks (historical, by zone and delivery year)

pjm_5cp_zonal.title: PJM Annual 5CP PDF — ComEd zonal loads at the five PJM RTO peaks
pjm_5cp_zonal.publisher: PJM (annual, summer Y peaks published mid-October Y)

pjm_oatt_att_m2_comed.title: PJM OATT Attachment M-2 (ComEd) — Determination of Capacity Peak Load Contributions
pjm_oatt_att_m2_comed.note: Defines the CPLC_(Y+1) two-branch formula. Portfolio_sum is the denominator of branch 2 and is computed by ComEd across the subset of customers with positive (ACustPL − ACustCPL); not separately published as a current-year scalar in PJM or ICC public filings.

ferc_er22_1520_001_deficiency_response.title: ComEd Att. M-2 amendment, FERC ER22-1520-001 deficiency response
ferc_er22_1520_001_deficiency_response.verification_math: 1798.5104 / 2033.653 = 0.884374; sample customer gap 0.27012 kW × 0.884374 = 0.2389 kW, matches exhibit-stated Customer Weather Sensitivity Adjustment.
ferc_er22_1520_001_deficiency_response.note: Single disclosed historical anchor for Σ_5Pc(ACustPL − ACustCPL) restricted to the Weather Sensitive Customer class (the relevant class for Rate BESH residential AC load). Current-year value is not public.

ComEdNPL_mw_by_year._source: pjm_wn_peaks xlsx, COMED zone, SUMMER, Delivery Year column
ComEdNPL_mw_by_year._note: 2026 and 2027 use the most recent published value (2025) as the locked baseline. Replace with PJM's actual filed value for the corresponding planning year when published (typically January of the year before).

AComEdCPL_mw_by_year._source: Mean of pjm.coincident_peak.comed_zone_load_mw across the 5 PJM 5CP hours per summer year, from PJM's annual 5CP PDF
AComEdCPL_mw_by_year._note: 2026 and 2027 use most recent value (2025) as the locked baseline. Re-derive from pjm.coincident_peak after PJM publishes the corresponding summer's 5CP PDF (mid-October).

portfolio_sum_mw_scenarios._source: STIPULATED — Σ_5Pc(ACustPL − ACustCPL) is computed by ComEd across the positive-gap customer population (per Att. M-2 §2) and the current-year value is not separately published. The FERC ER22-1520-001 deficiency response discloses Summer 2021 = 2,033.653 MW for Weather Sensitive Customers; see tariff_source.ferc_er22_1520_001_deficiency_response.
portfolio_sum_mw_scenarios._aggregation_inequality: Σ max(ACustPL_i − ACustCPL_i, 0) ≠ max(Σ ACustPL_i − Σ ACustCPL_i, 0). No PJM zonal feed (NSPL, weather-normalized peaks, load_recon_bill_deter_hrly) reconstructs this customer-population sum.
portfolio_sum_mw_scenarios._reporting: Layer 2 is reported across all three named scenarios as a side-table per EXPERIMENT_DESIGN.md §6. These are pre-registered scenario analyses, not confidence intervals.

capacity_rate_dollars_per_kw_month_by_ye._source: ComEd ICC Informational Sheet 4 (71st Revised), tariff_source.icc_capacity_rate
capacity_rate_dollars_per_kw_month_by_ye._note_2026: Locked: $10.13567/kW-Month, applies to billing periods June 2026 through May 2027 per Info Sheet 4.
capacity_rate_dollars_per_kw_month_by_ye._note_2027: Placeholder using 2026/27 value; ComEd files the 2027/28 program-year MCC in approximately April 2027. Re-lock when published.
